messages.igt_instructions:
This task examines how you make decisions.
You will see four decks. Each choice can result in a gain and a loss.
You start with an initial balance. Try to earn as much as possible.
Make one choice per trial. There are {trials} choices in this task.
Your gains and losses will be shown after each choice.

Please respond carefully. A percentage of your total winnings will be paid to you at the end of the experiment.

When you are ready, press {advance_key} to start.
messages.bart_instructions:
This task examines how you make decisions.
Try to earn as much as possible by inflating balloons.
Each pump adds money to the current balloon. If the balloon bursts, you earn nothing from that balloon.
Balloons have different burst points. Some can grow nearly as large as the screen; most burst earlier.

Press {pump_key} to pump. Press {collect_key} before the balloon bursts to transfer its value to your bank and move to the next balloon.
The balloon value shows the current reward; the bank shows money collected across the task.

Please respond carefully. A percentage of the money in your bank will be paid to you at the end of the experiment.

When you are ready, press {advance_key} to start.
messages.survey_instructions:
Please describe how you feel right now using the two scales below.
The first scale asks how calm or aroused you feel.
The second asks how unpleasant or pleasant you feel.
Rate each from 1 to 9 by clicking a number.
